title: Postcard Origin-Country Heatmap
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:postcard origin_country=*
| stats count as items by origin_country
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - share_pct
description: Shows how postcards split across origin country for collection geography.
value: Share-of-total views make it easier to see imbalance, over-concentration, and neglected areas inside collection geography.
implementation: Capture each postcards event in `memory:postcard` and normalize `origin_country` so Splunk can compute the share by origin country.
visualization: Table of origin country with item count and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how postcards are divided across origin country so you can tell if one part of collection geography is taking over.
